video.title: AI欧腐《被前任悔婚后，我成了他的继父/After My Ex Left Me at the Altar，I Became His Stepfather》
video.desc:
To repay his family’s debts, Elio is abandoned at the altar, only to be publicly married by his ex’s all-powerful Mafia father. Under the don’s fierce devotion, he rises from a pawn to the family’s ruler—and ultimately kills his treacherous ex himself.
为了偿还家族债务，Elio 走上了婚礼圣坛，却被当场抛弃——随即又被前任那位权势滔天的黑帮教父父亲，当众娶走。在教父炽烈的宠爱之下，他从一枚棋子一路登顶，成为家族的掌权者——并最终，亲手杀死了那个背信弃义的前任。
